# Jotun puffs

Type: Food | Internal ID: MushroomJotunPuffs | Source: Gathered in, Mistlands, and farmable | Usage: Crafting, Eating, Farming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Max Health: 25 | Max Stamina: 25 | Duration: 15m | Healing: 1 hp/tick | Produces: 3 Jotun puffs | Grow Time (s): 1h 6m 40s, -, 1h 23m 20s | Needs Cultivated Ground?: Yes | Space Needed (m): 1.6 | Hospitable Biomes: Mistlands

# Introduction

Jotun puffs are crops which grow in the Mistlands. They can be found naturally in the biome and farmed by planting them using a Cultivator.

## Availability

• Jotun puffs can be gathered in the Mistlands.
• Using a Cultivator, they can be planted in cultivated soil in the same biome, which is the only place they will grow. Like Flax and Barley, it is planted directly, rather than needing to farm seeds first. One planting will yield three Jotun puffs.

## Usage

• Can be replanted to produce more Jotun puffs using a Cultivator within the Mistlands.
• Can be eaten directly, but the Health and Stamina provided are far inferior to other foods available in its tier.

### Crafting

• Misthare supreme
• Honey glazed chicken
• Mushroom omelette
• Salad
• Mead base: Lingering stamina
• Mead base: Minor eitr
• Scorching medley

## Notes

• In real life, puffballs are mushrooms with characteristic ball-shaped tops that burst to spread their spores.
• In response to above, as everything in the Mistlands is scaled up in size proportionately, it is easier to assume that Jotun puffs are actually a type of slime mold, based off of their shape and size in relation to the environment.
